title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.14.0 - Unified Desktop & Social Update
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.14.0 - Unified Desktop & Social Update

- Windows and macOS now share the same application version number and release tag, with platform-specific signed download packages.
- New accounts complete a guided three-step setup before accessing the launcher: language, editable profile, and privacy preferences.
- Friends is now conversation-first, with immediate private messages, clearer member selection, and separate shared-games tabs.
- Improved smaller-screen layouts, Mac system labeling and game artwork; removed overlapping DropDash text from the game banner.
- macOS now uses the VENSUKO Keychain service without automatically reading legacy Lumorix session items. A one-time sign-in may be needed.
